channel.title: Hack the Platform Blog
channel.description: Deep technical write-ups on Power Platform, Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry — governance, plugins, integrations, and the internals underneath them.

item.title: Block GitHub Copilot Harness Agents with a Dataverse Plugin
item.description: Agents built on the GitHub Copilot harness consume Copilot Credits that a Microsoft 365 Copilot license does not cover, and there is no admin switch to turn them off. This post shows a Dataverse plugin that blocks their creation.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Block Copilot Studio in Default Environment with a Simple Plugin
item.description: Learn how to prevent users from creating Copilot agents in the Default Power Platform environment using a simple Dataverse plugin.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Choice Column with Single Value
item.description: Learn how to work with single-value Choice columns in Dataverse and configure them with Dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: LookUp Column with Multiple Values (Many-to-Many Relationships)
item.description: How to handle many-to-many relationships in Dataverse using Dataflows, with a detailed comparison of manual vs built-in approaches.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: LookUp Column with Single Value
item.description: In Part 3 of the Dataflows series, we focus on working with Dataverse Lookup Columns (Single Values) and how to prepare, map, and validate them in Power Platform dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Choice Column with Multiple Values
item.description: Learn how to handle multi-select Choice columns from SharePoint and map them into Dataverse using Power Query dataflows. This post walks through creating a custom lookup table, expanding and merging multiple values, and grouping them back into a format that Dataverse can store. Includes step-by-step guidance and Power Query code snippets.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Auto-Generate Azure Blob Folders from Dataverse Using a Plugin
item.description: Learn how to create a Dataverse plugin that automatically creates Azure Blob Storage folders for new records using REST API calls.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Fetching Dataverse Data Securely
item.description: In Part 3, we’ll connect our Power Pages + React SPA to Dataverse using the Web API. You’ll learn to enable API access, set permissions for authenticated users, and securely fetch data with CSRF token handling. We’ll also build a simple UI to display Accounts, validating our authentication setup from Part 2.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Starting a Power Automate Flow from React SPA
item.description: Learn how to securely start a Power Automate flow from your React SPA in Power Pages, fetching Dataverse data without exposing tables or permissions.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
